<!--
The milestone files in docs/04-plan/issues/ are the source of truth for task text.
Copy the task entry from its milestone file. If the issue and the file disagree, fix the file first.
#001–#097 are created in number order before any other issue or pull request, so that GitHub gives
each one its task number. A new task (#098 and up) takes the number GitHub gives its issue; its entry
is then added to the milestone file and to docs/04-plan/issues/README.md §3 in a pull request
(docs/05-development/workflow.md §2.4).
-->

| Depends on | #…, #… (or None) |
| Gate | G<n> (only if this task closes a gate) |
| Requirements | FR-…, NFR-… |
| Design | docs/02-design/….md §… |
| Modules / paths | |
| Risks / questions | R-…, OQ-… (or None) |
